parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a woman phoning to inquire about joining an international club.

First, you will have some time to look at questions one to six.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

Excuse me. I was trying to bother you, but I was wondering if you can help me to carrying out a survey about the community here. It won't take more than a couple of minutes.

Okay, no problem.

First of all, can I take your full name?

It's Alex Munali.

How do you spell your surname?

M-U-N-A-L-I.

Where do you live?

Flat twelve, one hundred three Fowler Road.

Is that F-A-U?

No. F-O-W-L-E-R.

All right. And that's road?

Right.

Do you know your postcode?

Let me see if I can remember it. Oh, yes, it's R-O six two L-R.

That's brilliant. Now, I will just ask you a few more questions. What do you do? Are you a student?

Actually, I am a waiter.

Fine. One more question. Can you help me fill in your age group? Fifteen to nineteen, twenty to twenty-five, or twenty-six to thirty.

I am twenty-seven.

Okay, thanks. Now, I'd like to ask you some questions about the local community services. For each question, you can say good, satisfactory, or poor. And the first question is about how clean the streets are.

Hm, that's a good question. I suppose I should say all right for that one, you know, in the middle.

What about buses, trams, et cetera? Do they provide a good service?

Actually, they hardly run on time, so I should say I am not totally impressed.

Right. Have you had much contact with the health services?

Not personally, but my friend had a serious operation recently.

And how is that going?

She had waited for a week before she had a treatment, so I should say it's not that good for the health services.

Okay, thank you. My next question, what about the police? Do you think they are doing a good job?

I don't have much to say, but generally not bad.

So I will put down satisfactory.

Yeah, you can say that.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

Okay. Now there are some more open questions. What would you like to say about the facilities here?

The air is quite fresh compared with other cities. That's because there are some national parks, and I can always take my wife for a walk there.

Aha, that's very nice. What else?

You know, although my children are not old enough yet, I think the schools here are of high standards with nice facilities and qualified teachers.

Okay. Now, any suggestions for improvements?

Well, actually, I am also new here. My family and I just moved in recently. I think you should ask the local people here if you want to get more detailed information.

Aha, that's a good idea. I will do that as well.

There is something else I can mention. The football pitch here is great. I always spend a whole Saturday afternoon there. But the swimming pool is quite old, twenty years at least. I think it really needs renovating.

Okay. Thank you so much for your time. My pleasure.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 录音中受访者明确把街道名字拼写为 F-O-W-L-E-R。
Where do you live? Flat twelve, one hundred three Fowler Road. Is that F-A-U? No. F-O-W-L-E-R.
你可能会因为提问者先猜了一个“F-A-U”就被带偏，一定要听清后面紧跟着的“No”和正确的拼写纠正。
Do you know your postcode? Let me see if I can remember it. Oh, yes, it's R-O six two L-R.
英文字母和数字混合在一起连读时很容易听漏或听错，你需要平时多熟悉这种组合的发音节奏。
受访者在努力回忆后，直接念出了邮政编码的组合 R-O six two L-R。
What do you do? Are you a student? Actually, I am a waiter.
你可能会听到提问者问“student”就顺手填了，要注意听后面表示真实情况的反转词“Actually”以及紧跟的正确职业。
面对提问者的询问，受访者明确说出自己的职业是服务员（waiter）。

questions.question: What is the respondent's opinion on the transport?

analyses.content: What about buses, trams, et cetera? Do they provide a good service? Actually, they hardly run on time, so I should say I am not totally impressed.
录音里根本没有直接念出 Poor 这个词，你如果死等原词就会做错，要理解“not totally impressed”在这里就是给出的差评。
受访者说公交车几乎不准时，而且他觉得不够满意（not totally impressed），这与 Poor（差）的意思完全对应。

questions.question: What is the respondent's opinion on the health services?

analyses.content: Have you had much contact with the health services? Not personally, but my friend had a serious operation recently. And how is that going? She had waited for a week before she had a treatment, so I should say it's not that good for the health services.
你可能会听到最开头的“Not personally”（我个人没接触过）就以为他不会给出评价了，必须要耐心听完他拿朋友举例并做出的最终负面结论。
受访者举了朋友看病等了一周的例子，最后直接总结说医疗服务没那么好（not that good），对应选项 Poor。

questions.question: What is the respondent's opinion on the police?

analyses.content: 受访者觉得警察做得还不错（not bad），并且直接同意了提问者帮你总结的“satisfactory”（令人满意的）。
My next question, what about the police? Do you think they are doing a good job? I don't have much to say, but generally not bad. So I will put down satisfactory. Yeah, you can say that.
你可能听到提问者说的“good job”就想选 Good，要注意这只是在提问，真正的答案在于后面俩人确认的“not bad”和“satisfactory”。

analyses.content: What would you like to say about the facilities here? The air is quite fresh compared with other cities. That's because there are some national parks, and I can always take my wife for a walk there.
题目字数限制是不超过两个词，你如果照抄录音把前面表示数量的“some”也写进去，就会因为超字数而被判错。
录音先说了空气很新鲜，紧接着就用“because”交代了新鲜空气的来源是国家公园（national parks）。
You know, although my children are not old enough yet, I think the schools here are of high standards with nice facilities and qualified teachers.
你可能会听到后面冒出来的“facilities”或“teachers”就填上去，但要注意这句话的主角是被评价具备高标准的学校。
录音明确指出这里的学校（schools）有很高的标准（of high standards），完美对应了题目里写的高质量（high quality）。
Well, actually, I am also new here. My family and I just moved in recently. I think you should ask the local people here if you want to get more detailed information.
答案就藏在一段比较长的解释说明里，如果你因为听前面的铺垫走神了，就会完美漏掉这句直白送分的答案句。
录音里原原本本地建议说，如果你想获得更详细的信息，最好去问当地人（local people）。
But the swimming pool is quite old, twenty years at least. I think it really needs renovating.
你可能会听到前面说的“football pitch”（足球场）就以为是答案，但录音里明确夸足球场很棒，后面用“But”转折后提到的游泳池才是真正需要变好的地方。
受访者认为游泳池（swimming pool）已经很旧了，非常需要翻修（needs renovating），这刚好对应了题目里的需要改进（needs to be improved）。
